explanation: His edicts were carved on rocks and pillars across the subcontinent. India adopted the lion capital from his pillar at Sarnath as its national emblem in 1950.

claims.text: Ashoka embraced Buddhism and renounced wars of conquest after his war in Kalinga.
The Gupta, Mughal and Kushan empires were not ruled by Ashoka.
Ashoka's edicts were inscribed on rocks and pillars across the Indian subcontinent.
In 1950 India adopted the lion capital from Ashoka's pillar at Sarnath as its national emblem.
